sources.citation: Z'graggen, J.A. 1971. Classificatory and typological studies in languages of the Madang District. Pacific Linguistics C-19. Canberra: ANU. 196 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Tangu section 2.23.21.11 (p.80) gives villages, prior sources (Holtker 1937b:964 fn.20; Van Baar unpublished religious texts; Capell 1952:141ff 'some notes on grammar and a wordlist') and lexicostatistics; Ataitan typological notes (sec. 2.23.21.3) mention only prenasalised voiced stops and /n/. The strings 'stress' and 'accent' do not occur in the whole volume's text layer.
